summary: Lucia Clinic has a famous founder, a strong team and press. The homepage has errors that visitors can see, and its booking buttons do not send them anywhere.

findings.problem: The Instagram section shows the visible error No feed with the ID 1 found, and the Moments Worth Sharing grid has blank image tiles.
findings.cost: A visible error on a premium clinic homepage makes patients doubt how well the clinic is run.
findings.fix: A working social feed or a clean section without it.

findings.problem: The hero Book An Appointment and BOOK NOW buttons link to #, and menu parents like Procedures and Face go nowhere. Booking is a callback form.
findings.cost: A patient ready to book clicks and nothing happens. That is a lost booking at a high value treatment price.
findings.fix: One working booking path with online scheduling, and WhatsApp as the second option.

findings.problem: Testimonials come mostly from celebrities and influencers, with no ordinary patient reviews, star ratings or counts. Before and after images have no captions.
findings.cost: Patients trust people like themselves and want to see the procedure and timeline behind each result.
findings.fix: Verified patient reviews with ratings and captioned before and after cases.

findings.problem: Typos and repeats: Tin Lips, 199,2 for a year, FACE and BODY headings doubled, Skin Tags listed twice, Anti-ageing and Anti-aging mixed.
findings.cost: Small errors weaken an image of precision that a medical aesthetic clinic depends on.
findings.fix: A proofread build with consistent copy and clean sections.

redesign: A premium homepage with one clear booking path and WhatsApp on every page.
Procedure pages that rank for searches like lip fillers Dubai and laser Dubai.
Real patient proof next to every booking button: reviews, stars and captioned results.
